title: Unexpected Invitation
next_chapter_hook: Han Lie lost face completely, seething with hatred in his heart, secretly contacting higher-level forces...

text.content: The atmosphere in the Council Hall suddenly froze, as if an invisible hand had seized everyone's throat. That aged yet commanding laughter pierced through the heavy doors, carrying a superior composure: 'I've merely been in seclusion for too long and wanted to see if there were any interesting matters in the sect. Continue, continue.' Before the words finished, a withered figure had already walked slowly through the door. Tianqing Sect's old Patriarch Ling Yuan, beneath his hunched back were eyes deep as an abyss, smiling cheerfully yet sending chills down everyone's spine. Chen Ji stood in the corner with head bowed, his expression respectful, but waves were already churning in his heart—this old fox's timing for exiting seclusion was a bit too coincidental.

dialogue.content: Oh? I've heard that our Tianqing Sect has produced a prodigy who can dominate the Outer Disciple Competition?

text.content: Ling Yuan's gaze swept across the crowd and finally landed on Chen Ji. That look was like sizing up an ant, or examining goods awaiting a price. Chen Ji felt a chill crawl from his feet to his crown—this old geezer definitely knows something. He lowered his eyes to hide the cold light in his gaze, his bow and respectful posture flawless. The elders exchanged puzzled glances, unsure what this old patriarch was scheming, only Su Qingyao's gaze shuttled between Chen Ji and Ling Yuan, lost in thought.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji是吧？不错，不错。年轻人，当得起一声夸奖。Young man, well done, well done. A young person who deserves such praise.

text.content: The tense atmosphere in the Council Hall dissipated under Ling Yuan's 'praise,' and everyone dispersed. When Chen Ji returned to the Servants' Quarters, the sun had already slanted west. He lay on the dilapidated wooden bed, staring at the ceiling in a daze—this old fox has emerged from seclusion, which means the plan needs to accelerate. Just then, a series of pompous knocks came at the courtyard gate: 'Where is Chen Ji? Young Master Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect has sent a letter. Come out quickly to receive it!'

dialogue.content: Long have I admired Brother Chen's great name, and my heart yearns for you. Recently I heard that during your sect's Outer Disciple Competition, Brother Chen defeated all enemies—a true young hero indeed. I wish to exchange pointers with Brother Chen, meeting as martial artists, at the Azure Platform at the border of our two sects in three days. I hope Brother Chen will not refuse, and I have prepared a modest gift—一块千年寒铁一块千年寒铁一块千年寒铁一块千年寒铁一块千年寒铁一块千年寒铁一块千年寒铁一块千年寒铁一块千年寒铁，to aid Brother Chen's cultivation. Remember, this is a private exchange—absolutely do not spread the word.

text.content: Chen Ji took the envelope, his fingertips gently stroking the delicate cloud-patterned texture on the envelope's surface, a hint of amusement flickering in his eyes. 一块千年寒铁一块千年寒铁？This is top-grade material for crafting spiritual artifacts. Han Lie sure is generous. But those eight characters 'private exchange' and 'absolutely do not spread the word'—how do they look? They say: Come, I'm going to kill you where no one can see, and don't let anyone witness my cheating. He tucked the envelope away and showed the pompous messenger a simple, honest smile: 'Please convey to Young Master Han that Chen will arrive on time and would never dare keep the young master waiting.'

dialogue.content: Young Master Han values me so highly; I am truly honored. However, the Azure Platform... is rather far. Could we change the location to the sect's Martial Arena? More people, livelier atmosphere, and it would also help promote Young Master Han's reputation.

text.content: The messenger's expression shifted slightly, clearly not expecting this 'waste' to bargain. He coldly snorted: 'Young Master Han's arrangements are not something a mere servant can comment on. Three days from now, Azure Platform, the Hour of Chen.' With that, he swept his sleeves and left, not even sparing another glance. Chen Ji watched the departing figure disappear beyond the courtyard gate, a meaningful smile curling at his lips. Interesting—has Han Lie really lost his composure, or does he have other schemes? He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record faintly warming in his mind一块千年寒铁 was tempting, but what intrigued him more was what backup plans Han Lie had prepared.

choice.prompt: Han Lie's invitation letter conceals a lethal trap. Chen Ji must decide how to respond to this 'sparring session':

choices.description: Regardless of any schemes, whether from heaven or hell—let come what may, I'll directly attend the appointment.
choices.visible_reward: Humiliating with strength is far more satisfying
choices.risk_hint: Azure Platform is remote; if something goes wrong, calling heaven or earth would be futile

text.content: Chen Ji played with the envelope for a moment, then casually set it aside. Go directly? Of course he could, but he never liked doing things without certainty. Moreover, this letter is full of traps—rushing to the appointment would only play right into Han Lie's hands. What he wanted was a foolproof plan—or rather, a situation where Han Lie would suffer in silence, unable to voice his complaints.

choices.description: Turn the tables; 'misinterpret' the invitation before the public, making Han Lie reap what he sows.
choices.visible_reward: Humiliate Han Lie publicly, and get the thousand-year cold iron for free
choices.risk_hint: If exposed on the spot, may lose all face

text.content: A cunning glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Han Lie啊 Han Lie, you've schemed endlessly yet forgotten one thing—this invitation letter will eventually be presented. Rather than being surrounded in some wild remote area... He tucked the envelope into his chest, his smile deepening. At the Martial Arena three days later, he would let the entire Tianqing Sect witness how the genius of the Xuanwu Sect would voluntarily admit defeat and offer treasures seeking peace.

Three days later, the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena. The sun was high and bright. Crowds of disciples gathered around the Martial Arena. It wasn't a special day, yet the place was packed—word had somehow spread that Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect was going to 'spar' with a Tianqing Sect outer disciple. The Xuanwu Sect's number one genius challenging a servant? The spectacle was even grander than the Sect Competition. The crowd whispered, eyes darting between the arena stage and its surroundings, all waiting to watch a good show.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! How dare you play tricks on me? The letter clearly stated Azure Platform—how dare you publicly read it at the Martial Arena?

text.content: Han Lie stood to one side of the arena platform, his face ashen. Today he had brought several trusted followers, arriving in grand fashion, expecting to secretly cripple Chen Ji at the Azure Platform. But the moment he entered, he realized something was wrong—the Martial Arena was packed, with several elders even seated on the high platform! Before he could react, Chen Ji had already smilingly opened the envelope and read it aloud. The worst part was, what Chen Ji read was completely different from what Han Lie had written! 'Sparring' became 'admiration,' 'Azure Platform' became 'Martial Arena,' and most outrageously, 'offering a modest gift' was read as 'offering a piece of thousand-year cold iron'—with the addition of Han Lie being 'truly convinced, specially coming to seek defeat.'

dialogue.content: Young Master Han, your letter has everything clearly written in black and white—'my heart yearns for you,' 'meeting as martial artists,' 'offering a modest gift.' You're the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, while I'm merely a servant. If you 'meet as friends' with me, isn't that 'seeking defeat'? And you're willing to offer such precious spiritual material as thousand-year cold iron—isn't that 'being truly convinced'?

text.content: The moment these words fell, the entire crowd erupted. Some couldn't hold back their laughter, others whispered amongst themselves, but most wore excited expressions of spectators hoping for a good show. Han Lie's face went from ashen to purple, then from purple to pallid—he, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, had been publicly outwitted by a servant today! The worst part was, he had actually brought that thousand-year cold iron, meant to bribe Chen Ji into going easy on him. Now it had become 'proof of his defeat.' He was caught between a rock and a hard place, riding the tiger with no way to dismount, and a raging fire burned in his chest.

dialogue.content: Since Young Master Han came for 'martial friendship,' why not show everyone the divine arts of the Xuanwu Sect?

text.content: Su Qingyao appeared in the crowd at some point, her single sentence directly blocking Han Lie's retreat. A faint smile played at her lips as her gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment—since when did this fellow learn such underhanded tricks? On the high platform, several elders also showed amused expressions. Ling Yuan sat in the armchair, supremely confident, but a flash of keen light darted through his eyes. Han Lie clenched his fists, his knuckles cracking. He knew that if he retreated without fighting today, he would never be able to hold his head up in the entire cultivation world. But if he fought and won, it was expected; if he lost... he dared not think.

choice.prompt: Han Lie is caught in a dilemma. Chen Ji must decide how to end this:

choices.description: Accept Han Lie's 'admission of defeat,' take the cold iron and leave, profiting in silence.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance to humiliate him publicly
choices.visible_reward: Get the thousand-year cold iron for free, and gain a reputation for being magnanimous
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may not be convinced and secretly harbor resentment

text.content: Chen Ji smilingly stepped forward, taking the piece of thousand-year cold iron glowing with a deep blue luster from Han Lie's hand, not forgetting to bow in gratitude: 'Young Master Han truly keeps his word; I am truly impressed. Since the young master is busy with affairs, let's conclude today's meeting. I'll seek guidance from the young master another day.' He patted Han Lie's shoulder, his voice just loud enough for those nearby to hear: 'Rest assured, your kindness, I will forever remember in my heart.'

choices.description: Since Han Lie came, might as well make him lose all face before everyone.
choices.visible_cost: May completely provoke Han Lie, inviting greater retaliation
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie loses face completely, becoming famous across both sects
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's combat power is indeed strong; if they really fight, the outcome is hard to predict

text.content: But Chen Ji had no intention of stopping there. He looked around and announced loudly: 'Fellow brothers and sisters, Young Master Han traveled all this way—how could I let him leave empty-handed? How about this—since the young master came to 'seek defeat,' I'll reluctantly exchange a few moves with him.' Before his words even finished, cheers erupted from the crowd. Han Lie's face turned completely dark, a狠厉 flash crossing his eyes: 'Good! Good one, eloquent Chen Ji! Since you're seeking death, I'll grant your wish!'

On the arena platform, gale winds rose. Spiritual energy surged around Han Lie as he activated the Xuanwu Sect's sect-founding technique 'Xuanming True Water Art' to its extreme. A layer of deep blue water screen materialized before him. He coldly stared at Chen Ji, a mocking smile curling his lips: 'A waste dares to make this young master personally act? Today I'll teach you what it means to know one's place!' With that, he struck forward, deep blue water waves surged like flood dragons bursting from the sea, rushing directly toward Chen Ji. Spectating disciples cried out—this palm strike, not to mention a servant disciple, might even be more than an inner disciple could handle!

Yet Chen Ji only faintly smiled, neither dodging nor evading. His right hand gently rose, a faint golden light gathering at his fingertips—the opening move of 'Tianqing Art,' the basic technique every outer disciple in the sect knows. But this simplest of moves, in his hands seemed to contain some indescribable rhythm. Golden light collided with water waves—no earth-shaking explosion, only sizzling sounds as the raging waters were slowly cut and dissolved by the golden light, eventually turning into scattered mist and vanishing into nothing. Complete silence fell over the arena. Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, gazing in disbelief at the scene before him—his full-power strike, actually blocked so easily by a 'waste' using the most basic technique?

Young Master Han, you honor me with your concession. It seems today the young master failed to 'seek defeat,' and instead let me gain the advantage. This cold iron, I'll gladly accept. He bent down to pick up the thousand-year cold iron from the ground, tucked it into his chest before everyone's eyes, then turned to leave. Han Lie trembled with rage, about to pursue, but saw Ling Yuan on the high platform slowly speak: 'This is merely friendly sparring, a touch of the point. Young Master Han is a guest of our Xuanwu Sect—no need to harm harmony over a trivial matter.' One sentence from the old patriarch settled everything. Han Lie could only gnash his teeth while standing there, watching Chen Ji's figure disappear into the crowd, the fire in his chest nearly burning his rationality to ashes.

The crowd gradually dispersed, and the Martial Arena returned to tranquility. Su Qingyao stood rooted in place, gazing in the direction Chen Ji had departed, a complex light flickering in her eyes. The scene just now, she had seen clearly—Chen Ji did indeed use the 'Tianqing Art,' but the spiritual energy circulation method within was slightly different from what the sect's records stated. More importantly, his composure when blocking Han Lie's strike was by no means what a 'waste' should possess. Her suspicion grew clearer: this servant disciple was far from simple. She just never imagined that that seemingly simple-minded少年, at this moment, was tucking the thousand-year cold iron against his chest, a smug smile on his lips, mentally adding Han Lie to his list: What you owe me, you will repay.
